name: rulespec
description: Business rules as structured YAML data, compiled into LLM-ready SKILL.md prompts. Native tools for the full lifecycle (init, list, add/edit/remove rule, sources, examples, compile, validate, emit, replace).

approval.description: Approval gate for `rulespec_emit` (the only write that publishes a SKILL.md agents follow). Other writes run silently.

approval.label: Emit approval gate
approval.help: Prompt before `rulespec_emit` runs. Set enabled=false to disable, or add session-key substrings to skipSessionPatterns for unattended automation.
